rooms.title: Make the first pendulum visible
rooms.observed: The pale bob, rod and prediction nearly disappear against the bright floor; the counter is distant and small.
rooms.preserve: Keep the actual pendulum, signed state and already-running counter.
rooms.request: Give the bob and prediction distinct contrast and a clear visual support; bring the existing state readout into the same useful viewing area. Avoid making the prediction look like a second physical string.
rooms.acceptance: From the approach and release position, see the bob, its ring and the signs/count without losing the hand target.

rooms.title: See the bob and its history together
rooms.observed: The primary view is obstructed by the blank back of a foreground panel. The separate readout is much clearer.
rooms.preserve: Keep the gallows, bounded trail, sampling modes and successful cased timing plate.
rooms.request: Turn or relocate the obstructing panel onto the operator side and make a clear side view along the history. Improve trail contrast against the floor; preserve deliberate platforms.
rooms.acceptance: One standing frame contains bob, useful trail length and readable controls; walk-side access survives. Investigate the pictured floor hole before deciding whether it is intentional.

rooms.title: Fit the explanation to its casing
rooms.observed: The long readout line escapes its black plate at the approach; the little panel competes with the large support block. The folds themselves make a strong spatial encounter.
rooms.preserve: Keep the red membranes, supported passage, phase comparison and the documented collision-free surfaces.
rooms.request: Reflow the existing readout into legible lines inside its casing; place the panel for an unobstructed view into the passage and make the entrance/exit floor boundary clear.
rooms.acceptance: At the approach, all readout text fits and the panel can be used while seeing both walls; at mid-passage the exit remains identifiable.

rooms.title: Let the hands lead the sound comparison
rooms.observed: The large central readout obscures the carrier/modulator interaction area; the scope is cropped from the operating view. The overview is crowded with backs of displays.
rooms.preserve: Keep the two-ball mapping, held A/B notes and scope tied to synthesis.
rooms.request: Move the readout beside or below the hand space, house readable audition controls within reach, and stage one clear approach to both balls and the scope. Preserve secondary sound instruments in useful positions.
rooms.acceptance: An operating view shows both hand targets, buttons and the relevant scope/readout; repeat A/B. Investigate the fresh proximity-audio assertion separately; images cannot certify listening.

rooms.title: Make taking and returning the striker obvious
rooms.observed: The colour bars and continuing waveform are clear. The long striker lies across the playable row, with a void behind the instrument and competing titles above.
rooms.preserve: Keep the coloured instrument, overlapping voices and the strange neighbouring bodies.
rooms.request: Give the striker an obvious accessible rest that leaves the bars free, distinguish the playable edge from the rear void, and quiet overlapping secondary captions in the primary viewing direction.
rooms.acceptance: Capture arrival with the striker at rest, one strike, and two voices after release; demonstrate retrieval. Retain the fresh shutdown failure as a separate unresolved issue.

rooms.title: Clear the operating view of the synthesis console
rooms.observed: Large red geometry fills the desktop operating view and covers most of the waveform and controls.
rooms.preserve: Keep the harmonic sum, its reference/hold comparison and meaningful sculptural bodies.
rooms.request: Identify the obstructing geometry in the running hall and relocate or bound its movement so it does not fill the operator space. Protect the view throughout animation, not only for a photograph.
rooms.acceptance: From the real operating position, see and use the sliders while following the resultant wave, including the animation extremes and held comparison.

rooms.title: Make the first comparison easy to operate
rooms.observed: The two grids have a clear shared view. The small cream controller is washed out and its action names are much harder to read than the floating title.
rooms.preserve: Keep the matched grids, local seed and discarded-draw experiment.
rooms.request: Improve controller label contrast and the relation between the housed controls and their grid pair. Give the active seed/action a readable local place without expanding the text wall.
rooms.acceptance: Read REPLAY, RANDOM and +1 DRAW at the operating position and see both grids through the change; preserve the useful swarm elsewhere.

rooms.title: Make individual draws inspectable
rooms.observed: The long row is a good argument but 200 tiny tiles become a thin strip at approach distance. The lower readout is stronger than the upper labels.
rooms.preserve: Keep the sorted-copy comparison and completed source-law/build-once corrections; do not restart the old R1 repair.
rooms.request: Improve close inspection of neighbouring draws with an accessible viewing edge or a clearly labelled magnified excerpt of the same sample. Tune the existing upper labels and buttons to a shared readable contrast.
rooms.acceptance: Pick two neighbours before SORT and locate their colours afterwards without inventing new samples; the same counts and H remain inspectable.

rooms.title: Keep the grid visible while choosing
rooms.observed: The large sloped control panel hides the near rows of the tray; the state text floats much farther away.
rooms.preserve: Keep the owned grid, visible eligibility mask, local reset and non-repeating removal.
rooms.request: Move the controller to the side or lower it so the full tray remains visible during an action; bring a compact housed eligible/remaining readout alongside the tray.
rooms.acceptance: From one operating view, see the highlighted candidate, the front rows, the resulting absence and the relevant counts. Museum cells remain outside the operation.

rooms.title: Make the moving point and retained trail visible
rooms.observed: The tank nearly vanishes into the bright room; its small point is faint, while the pink floor geometry draws more attention.
rooms.preserve: Keep the cabinet, local repeatable walk and bounded history.
rooms.request: Give the tank a restrained contrasting back or rim and distinguish current point from trail by shape/brightness as well as colour. Integrate the side buttons and logbook with the cabinet.
rooms.acceptance: From a standing position, track the next step and tell it apart from the retained past; keep the actual trail limit and reset behavior.

rooms.title: Make the measurement readable before the inventory
rooms.observed: The cabinet gives the experiment a home, but its six-line readout is small from the operating view and the separate summary board is hard to decipher.
rooms.preserve: Keep both outboard panels, fixed-N batches, re-binning of kept draws, expected frames and the recovered floor.
rooms.request: Prioritise law, landed N, bins and edge clipping at readable size; move secondary details into an intentional close view. Remove overlapping or redundant label arrangements without losing the measurement account.
rooms.acceptance: The visitor can read the current comparison while watching BATCH and BINS. The same kept sample is visibly re-binned; compare the north and south approaches.

rooms.title: Connect the specimens to the meadow
rooms.observed: The new R4 capture now has a specimen counter and real comparison controls: the earlier inspection-edge request is already answered. At standing distance the numbered pads and readout are small, and pale field highlights compete with the bright meadow.
rooms.preserve: Keep the new specimen counter, SHOW/KIND/SIZE and seeded REGROW controls, the varied meadow and surreal companions. Build on the current R4 implementation.
rooms.request: Make the selected specimen and its corresponding field instances easier to recognise together. Improve the small pad labels and selected-kind readout locally, and choose a field highlight that remains clear against pale caps and grass.
rooms.acceptance: From the counter, choose two different kinds and locate their highlighted instances in the same population. Return matched views before/after SHOW and KIND, plus both doors; preserve the existing seed and rejected-candidate accounting.

scope: All twelve wavefunction/randomness halls with Claude work or a survey; Random_Game and unworked extensions are outside this capture set.
